content:
IVX CHAT FIX — FINAL DEVICE QA AND HONEST ACCEPTANCE

The code and deployment are accepted.

Do not call the chat defect VERIFIED yet because Android, iOS, and web behavior were not tested.

Complete actual device QA now.

1. ANDROID QA

On the production Android app:

- Force close the app.
- Reopen IVX.
- Open IVX Chat.
- Verify the most recently active conversation opens.
- Verify the newest message is immediately visible.
- Verify there is no visible movement through old messages.
- Verify the yellow down-arrow is not shown on initial open.
- Verify message order is correct.
- Verify date separators are correct.
- Send one message.
- Receive one realtime message.
- Scroll to older history.
- Load another pagination page.
- Verify visible position does not jump.
- Verify no duplicate messages.
- Open keyboard and close keyboard.
- Close and reopen the conversation.
- Restart the app and reopen chat.

Provide a new screen recording from app launch through chat open.

2. DOUBLE-REVERSAL AUDIT

Audit whether the implementation uses both:

- FlatList inverted={true}
- reversed message data

Prove that this does not reverse the message order twice.

Return the actual message sequence used by the list for five known messages.

Required:

NEWEST MESSAGE LOCATION: correct
OLDEST MESSAGE LOCATION: correct
DATE SEPARATORS: correct
PAGINATION DIRECTION: correct

3. IOS QA

Run the same tests on iOS.

If unavailable, report BLOCKED, not PASS.

4. WEB QA

Run the same tests in the live web chat.

Verify:

- latest message opens immediately
- no visible jump
- order correct
- pagination correct
- realtime correct
- no duplicates
- mobile browser layout correct

5. FINAL ACCEPTANCE VALUES

Return:

ANDROID CHAT OPEN: PASS/FAIL
IOS CHAT OPEN: PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED
WEB CHAT OPEN: PASS/FAIL
LATEST MESSAGE IMMEDIATELY VISIBLE: true/false
VISIBLE INITIAL JUMP: true/false
YELLOW ARROW ON INITIAL OPEN: true/false
MESSAGE ORDER CORRECT: true/false
DATE SEPARATORS CORRECT: true/false
PAGINATION PRESERVES POSITION: true/false
DUPLICATE MESSAGES: 0
REALTIME RECONNECT: PASS/FAIL
KEYBOARD QA: PASS/FAIL
SCREEN RECORDING: provided/not provided

Only use:

VERIFIED — CHAT OPENS AT THE NEWEST MESSAGE

when the actual production screen passes the device tests.

Otherwise use:

PARTIAL — CODE DEPLOYED, DEVICE BEHAVIOR NOT VERIFIED
FAILED — DEFECT REMAINS
